name: feedback-gate
description: Claude Code hooks that inject feedback rules, enforce them on tool calls and at stop time, and run per-project quality gates defined in .claude/gate.yaml

agentLaunchGuard.title: Agent launch guard
agentLaunchGuard.description: Ask for confirmation, showing the full prompt, before launching code-implementer or sending a message to any agent other than git-operator.

rulesFile.title: Rules file
rulesFile.description: Path to a Markdown file injected into every prompt in place of the bundled rules/feedback_rules.md. If the file does not exist, the bundled file is used. A leading ~ is expanded to your home directory.
